description: AICTIONBOT™ Freigabematrix-Prüfer by KULIC Advisory. Checks an approval matrix (area, level, approver, limits, deputy, system) against a people list (status, leaving date, absence, system role) and optional open approvals, and returns the rows that need action: approvers who left, are absent without a cover, lack a system role, missing deputies, limit gaps and overlaps, plus open approvals stuck with those people. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Findings are written in German. Keys may be German (bereich, stufe, freigeber, limit_von, limit_bis, waehrung, vertreter, system; person, status, austritt, abwesend_bis, systemrolle; beleg, bereich, betrag, wartet_bei, seit) or English (area, level, approver, limit_from, limit_to, currency, deputy, system; person, status, left_on, absent_until, system_role; document, area, amount, waiting_with, since).

open_approvals.description: Optional open approvals: document, area, amount, waiting_with, since, system.

people.description: People list with status (active, left, absent), left_on, absent_until, system_role (yes/no).

name: check_approval_matrix
title: Check an approval matrix against the people list: who approves although they left, lack a role or have no deputy
